festival.cn: 节日让不同文化聚到一起。

world.en: People around the world celebrate the New Year in different ways.
world.cn: 世界各地的人用不同方式过新年。

Halloween.en: On Halloween, children dress up and ask for sweets.
Halloween.cn: 万圣节孩子化装去要糖果。

Thanksgiving.en: Families gather for a big turkey dinner on Thanksgiving.
Thanksgiving.cn: 感恩节家人聚在一起吃火鸡大餐。

Mid-Autumn.en: On Mid-Autumn night, we look at the round bright moon.
Mid-Autumn.cn: 中秋夜我们抬头看圆圆的明月。

moon cake.en: Grandma makes moon cakes with red bean filling.

tradition.en: Eating dumplings is an important tradition at Spring Festival.
tradition.cn: 春节吃饺子是重要的传统。

celebrate.en: Different countries celebrate the same festival in different ways.
celebrate.cn: 不同国家用不同方式庆祝同一个节日。
